```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Background

Quick comparison of selected analytes measured during SuRGE, the two most recent NLA campaigns (NLA17 and NLA22), and lagos.

## Data

Required data are created via the targets pipeline. Load data here.

```{r data, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tar_load(dat_raw)
tar_load(lagos_chem)
dat_lagos <- left_join(lagos_chem, dat_raw, relationship = "many-to-many")
```


## Extraction based chlorophyll a
We are missing extraction-based chlorophyll a measurements for `r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(chla_lab_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1)) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` SuRGE lakes (mostly 2016 lakes). `r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(chla_lab_shallow) & (!is.na(nla17_chla) | !is.na(nla22_chla)) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1)) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` of these lakes have chla estimates from 2017 and/or 2022 NLA. `r dat_lagos %>% filter(is.na(chla_lab_shallow) & (!is.na(lagos_chla_shallow)) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1)) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` of these lakes have chla estimates from LAGOS. 

As expected, the concurrence among SuRGE and NLA observations is not great. 

The LAGOS data highlight the temporal variation within a lake (LAGOS has time series for most lakes, hover cursor over point to reveal sample date). Matching values by sample data is likely important. We could impute chla for lake  `r dat_lagos %>% filter(is.na(chla_lab_shallow) & (!is.na(lagos_chla_shallow))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% pull()` from LAGOS, but the SuRGE sampling was conducted on  `r dat_lagos %>% filter(is.na(chla_lab_shallow) & (!is.na(lagos_chla_shallow))) %>% distinct(sample_start) %>% pull()` whereas the LAGOS sampling dates were `r dat_lagos %>% filter(is.na(chla_lab_shallow) & (!is.na(lagos_chla_shallow))) %>% distinct(sample_date) %>% pull()`.


None of the available chla data were collected in same year as SuRGE sampling. Maybe not a good idea to impute these values. Are there other data sources we can mine? See here for some 2013-2014 data (https://dam.assets.ohio.gov/image/upload/epa.ohio.gov/Portals/35/tmdl/2016IR.pdf)

`r full_join(dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(chla_lab_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1) & (!is.na(nla17_chla) | !is.na(nla22_chla))) %>% distinct(lake_id, sample_start, nla17_chla, nla22_chla) %>% rename(SuRGE_sample_date = sample_start),            dat_lagos %>% filter(is.na(chla_lab_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1) & !is.na(lagos_chla_shallow)) %>% select(lake_id, sample_start, sample_date, lagos_chla_shallow) %>% distinct() %>% rename(SuRGE_sample_date = sample_start, lagos_sample_date = sample_date)) %>% kableExtra::kable(caption = "Table 3. NLA and LAGOS chla data for missing lakes") %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)`


```{r chla_plot, echo=FALSE}

{dat_raw %>%
    select(lake_id, nla17_site_id, nla22_site_id,
           chla_lab_shallow, nla17_chla, nla22_chla) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(nla17_chla, nla22_chla),
      names_to = "nla_year",
      values_to = "nla_chla"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(nla_chla), !is.na(chla_lab_shallow)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(nla17_site_id, nla22_site_id),
      names_to = "nla_parameter",
      values_to = "nla_site_id"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(nla_site_id)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      nla_chla, chla_lab_shallow, 
      text = paste("SuRGE:", chla_lab_shallow, "<br>",
                   "NLA:", nla_chla, "<br>",
                   "nla_site_id:", nla_site_id, "<br>",
                   "SuRGE lake_id:", lake_id),
      color = nla_year
    )
    ) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggtitle("Extraction Based Chlorophyll a") +
    xlab("NLA chla") +
    ylab("SuRGE chla")} %>%
  ggplotly(tooltip = "text")


{dat_lagos %>%
    select(lake_id, lagoslakeid, sample_date,
           chla_lab_shallow, lagos_chla_shallow) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(!is.na(lagos_chla_shallow)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      lagos_chla_shallow, chla_lab_shallow, 
      text = paste("SuRGE:", chla_lab_shallow, "<br>",
                   "LAGOS:", lagos_chla_shallow, "<br>",
                   "lagoslakeid:", lagoslakeid, "<br>",
                   "SuRGE lake_id:", lake_id, "<br>",
                   "LAGOS sample date:", sample_date),
      color = as.factor(lake_id)
    )
    ) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggtitle("Extraction Based Chlorophyll a") +
    xlab("LAGOS chla") +
    ylab("SuRGE chla")} %>%
  ggplotly(tooltip = "text")
```


## SO4
Sulfate wasn't measured until 2021 and we are missing data for `r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(so4_shallow)) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` SuRGE lakes. `r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(so4_shallow) & (!is.na(nla17_sulfate) | !is.na(nla22_sulfate))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` of these lakes have sulfate estimates from 2017 and/or 2022 NLA and `r dat_lagos %>% filter(is.na(so4_shallow) & (!is.na(lagos_so4_shallow))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` of these lakes have sulfate estimates from LAGOS. 


Comparison of SuRGE and NLA sulfate measurements is actually pretty good. Interestingly, most of the outliers in the plot below are in New Mexico South Dakota. I double checked the NLA and SuRGE data for these sites and don't see any issues. The New Mexico data shown are the mean of visits 1 and 2, which had very similar results. NLA sampled NLA22_NM-10013 in 2017 and 2022 with very similar results (data shown, 243 vs 83). 

Comparison with LAGOS is also pretty good. Again, the time series is useful for visualizing temporal variation.

The table shows the available data for the missing observations. A few lakes have observations over multiple years and these show pretty good agreement. I think we can impute the missing SO4 using NLA and LAGOS, but that still leaves 31 lakes with no data. We may need to dig a bit for lake-specific data reports.



`r full_join(dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(so4_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1) & (!is.na(nla17_sulfate) | !is.na(nla22_sulfate))) %>% distinct(lake_id, sample_start, nla17_sulfate, nla22_sulfate) %>% rename(SuRGE_sample_date = sample_start, NLA17_SO4 = nla17_sulfate, NLA22_SO4 = nla22_sulfate),  dat_lagos %>% filter(is.na(so4_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1) & !is.na(lagos_so4_shallow)) %>% select(lake_id, sample_start, sample_date, lagos_so4_shallow) %>% distinct() %>% rename(SuRGE_sample_date = sample_start, lagos_sample_date = sample_date)) %>% kableExtra::kable(caption = "Table 3. NLA and LAGOS SO4 data for missing lakes") %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)`

```{r so4_plot, echo=FALSE}
{dat_raw %>%
  select(lake_id, nla17_site_id, nla22_site_id,
         so4_shallow, nla17_sulfate, nla22_sulfate) %>%

    cols = c(nla17_sulfate, nla22_sulfate),
    names_to = "nla_year",
    values_to = "nla_so4"
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(nla_so4), !is.na(so4_shallow)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(nla17_site_id, nla22_site_id),
      names_to = "nla_parameter",
      values_to = "nla_site_id"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(nla_site_id)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      nla_so4, so4_shallow, 
      text = paste("SuRGE:", so4_shallow, "<br>",
                   "NLA:", nla_so4, "<br>",
                   "nla_site_id:", nla_site_id, "<br>",
                   "SuRGE lake_id:", lake_id),
      color = nla_year
    )
    ) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggtitle("Sulfate") +
    xlab("NLA SO4") +
    ylab("SuRGE SO4")} %>%
  ggplotly(tooltip = "text")


{dat_lagos %>%
    select(lake_id, lagoslakeid, sample_date,
           so4_shallow, lagos_so4_shallow) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(!is.na(lagos_so4_shallow)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      lagos_so4_shallow, so4_shallow, 
      text = paste("SuRGE:", so4_shallow, "<br>",
                   "LAGOS:", lagos_so4_shallow, "<br>",
                   "lagoslakeid:", lagoslakeid, "<br>",
                   "SuRGE lake_id:", lake_id, "<br>",
                   "LAGOS sample date:", sample_date),
      color = as.factor(lake_id)
    )
    ) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggtitle("Sulfate") +
    xlab("LAGOS SO4") +
    ylab("SuRGE SO4")} %>%
  ggplotly(tooltip = "text")
```

## TN
We are missing TN measurements for `r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(tn_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1)) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` SuRGE lakes. NLA contains TN observations for `r if(dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(tn_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1) & (!is.na(nla17_ntl) | !is.na(nla22_ntl))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow() == 0) {print("none")} else {dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(tn_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1) & (!is.na(nla17_ntl) | !is.na(nla22_ntl))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()}` of these lakes. LAGOS contains TN for 
`r dat_lagos %>% filter(is.na(tn_shallow) & (!is.na(lagos_tn_shallow))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` of these lakes.

The NLA comparison with TN is pretty good. Also, the 2 lakes with NLA17 and NLA22 observations agree pretty well (Table 2). I think we can imput the missing SuRGE data with the NLA numbers, especially the 2 NLA22 lakes.

`r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(tn_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1) & (!is.na(nla17_ntl) | !is.na(nla22_ntl))) %>% distinct(lake_id, sample_start, nla17_ntl, nla22_ntl) %>% rename(SuRGE_sample_date = sample_start, NLA17_TN = nla17_ntl, NLA22_TN = nla22_ntl) %>% kableExtra::kable(caption = "Table 2. NLA TN data for missing lakes") %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)`
```{r tn_plot, echo=FALSE}
{dat_raw %>%
    select(lake_id, nla17_site_id, nla22_site_id,
           tn_shallow, 
           nla17_ntl, 
           nla22_ntl) %>% 
    distinct() %>%
        mutate(nla17_ntl = nla17_ntl * 1000,
           nla22_ntl = nla22_ntl * 1000) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(nla17_ntl, nla22_ntl),
      names_to = "nla_year",
      values_to = "nla_ntl"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(nla_ntl),
      !is.na(tn_shallow)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(nla17_site_id, nla22_site_id),
      names_to = "nla_parameter",

    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(nla_site_id)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      nla_ntl, tn_shallow,

    )

    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggtitle("Total Nitrogen") +
    xlab("NLA TN") +
    ylab("SuRGE TN") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30000, 1000))} %>%
  ggplotly(tooltip = "text")


{dat_lagos %>%
    select(lake_id, lagoslakeid, sample_date,
           tn_shallow, lagos_tn_shallow) %>%

## DOC
We are missing DOC measurements for `r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(doc_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1)) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` SuRGE lakes. NLA contains DOC observations for `r if(dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(doc_shallow) & (!is.na(nla17_doc) | !is.na(nla22_doc))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow() == 0) {print("none")} else {dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(doc_shallow) & (!is.na(nla17_doc) | !is.na(nla22_doc))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()}` of these lakes. LAGOS contains data for 
`r dat_lagos %>% filter(is.na(doc_shallow) & (!is.na(lagos_doc_shallow))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` of these lakes.

Pretty good concurence between NLA and SuRGE DOC, a bit weaker with LAGOS, but look at the data in table 3. Very good concurence between repeat measurements at one lake, even across multiple years. I think we can impute the missing DOC using NLA and LAGOS, but that still leaves 29 lakes with no data. We may need to dig a bit for lake-specific data reports.

`r full_join(dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(doc_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1) & (!is.na(nla17_doc) | !is.na(nla22_doc))) %>% distinct(lake_id, sample_start, nla17_doc, nla22_doc) %>% rename(SuRGE_sample_date = sample_start, NLA17_TN = nla17_doc, NLA22_TN = nla22_doc),  dat_lagos %>% filter(is.na(doc_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1) & !is.na(lagos_doc_shallow)) %>% select(lake_id, sample_start, sample_date, lagos_doc_shallow) %>% distinct() %>% rename(SuRGE_sample_date = sample_start, lagos_sample_date = sample_date)) %>% kableExtra::kable(caption = "Table 3. NLA and LAGOS DOC data for missing lakes") %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)`

                   "LAGOS:", lagos_doc_shallow, "<br>",

                   "SuRGE lake_id:", lake_id, "<br>",
                   "LAGOS sample date:", sample_date),
      color = as.factor(lake_id)
    )
    ) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggtitle("DOC") +
    xlab("LAGOS DOC") +
    ylab("SuRGE DOC")} %>%
  ggplotly(tooltip = "text")
```

## TOC
We are missing shallow TOC measurements for `r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(toc_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1)) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` SuRGE lakes (aside from visit 1 to lakes 250 and 281 where the samples were lost in mail).

## pH
We are missing shallow pH measurements for `r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(ph_shallow)) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` SuRGE lakes. NLA contains pH observations for `r if(dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(ph_shallow) & (!is.na(nla17_ph) | !is.na(nla22_ph))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow() == 0) {print("none")} else {dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(ph_shallow) & (!is.na(nla17_ph) | !is.na(nla22_ph))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()}` of these lakes.  LAGOS contains pH for 
`r dat_lagos %>% filter(is.na(ph_shallow) & (!is.na(lagos_ph_shallow))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` of these lakes.

{dat_lagos %>%

## Specific Conductivity
We are missing shallow specific conductivity measurements for `r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(sp_cond_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1)) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` SuRGE lakes. NLA contains specific conductivity observations for `r if(dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(sp_cond_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1) & (!is.na(nla17_cond) | !is.na(nla22_cond))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow() == 0) {print("none")} else {dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(sp_cond_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1) & (!is.na(nla17_cond) | !is.na(nla22_cond))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()}` of these lakes. LAGOS contains specific conductivity for 
`r dat_lagos %>% filter(is.na(sp_cond_shallow) & (!is.na(lagos_sp_cond_shallow))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` of these lakes.


`r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(sp_cond_shallow) & !(lake_id %in% c(250, 281) & visit == 1) & (!is.na(nla17_cond) | !is.na(nla22_cond))) %>% distinct(lake_id, sample_start, nla17_cond, nla22_cond) %>% rename(SuRGE_sample_date = sample_start, NLA17_sp_cond = nla17_cond, NLA22_sp_cond = nla22_cond) %>% kableExtra::kable(caption = "Table 4. NLA sp_cond data for missing lakes") %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)`
